[SWS_EM_01210] Report kRunning received event to Platform Health Manage-
ment
⌈
Execution Management
shall inform
Platform Health Management
if a
Supervised
process
has reported Execution State
kRunning
.
⌋
(RS_EM_00103)
Platform Health Management
needs the information that termination of a Super-
vised
process
will be initiated ([SWS_EM_01055]) to stop Intra-process Supervisions.
